articles.title_en: On self- and other-regarding cooperation: Kant versus Berge
articles.title_cn: 论自利与他利合作：康德均衡与伯奇均衡
articles.abstract_en: This study analyzes the space of all continuous and discrete games to see whether self- and other-regarding cooperation are similar or inherently different. The solution concept for self-regarding cooperation is the Kantian equilibrium while other-regarding (i.e., altruistic) cooperation corresponds to the Berge equilibrium. We find that any Pareto-efficient Berge is generically a Kantian equilibrium in all symmetric games (e.g., prisoner's dilemma, stag hunt, etc.), whether they are continuous or discrete. In asymmetric games, however, Kant and Berge are generically different. These results suggest that self- and other-regarding cooperation is tight-knit under symmetry, a ubiquitous assumption in applied game theory, albeit asymmetric games do not allow a similar close connection.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了所有连续和离散博弈的空间，以考察自利与他利合作是相似还是本质上不同。自利合作的解概念是康德均衡，而他利（即利他）合作对应伯奇均衡。我们发现，在所有对称博弈（如囚徒困境、猎鹿博弈等）中，任何帕累托有效的伯奇均衡通常也是康德均衡，无论这些博弈是连续的还是离散的。然而，在非对称博弈中，康德均衡与伯奇均衡通常是不同的。这些结果表明，在对称性（应用博弈论中一个普遍假设）下，自利与他利合作紧密相连，尽管非对称博弈不允许类似的紧密联系。

articles.title_en: Learning through period and physical time
articles.title_cn: 通过周期时间和物理时间学习
articles.abstract_en: We demonstrate in a laboratory experiment in which subjects play a two-player Cournot-Tullock game over hundreds of periods of varying length that full accounts of subjects' learning requires the consideration of, both, ‘period time’ and ‘physical time.’
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个实验室实验中证明，受试者在数百个长度不同的周期中玩双人古诺-塔洛克博弈，对受试者学习的完整解释需要考虑‘周期时间’和‘物理时间’两者。

articles.title_en: Optimal and fair prizing in sequential round-robin tournaments: Experimental evidence
articles.title_cn: 序贯循环赛中的最优与公平奖金设置：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We experimentally investigate how the prize structure affects the intensity, fairness, and dynamic behavior in sequential round-robin tournaments with three players. We compare tournaments with a second prize equal to either 0%, 50%, or 100% of the first prize. While theory predicts the 50%-treatment to be most intense, we find that aggregate effort is highest in the 0%-treatment. In contrast, our evidence supports the predictions that the 50%-treatment is fairest (though not perfectly fair), whereas the late mover is advantaged in the 100%-treatment and disadvantaged in the 0%-treatment. Also in line with the theory, we identify a strategic (reverse) momentum: after winning the first match, a player increases (decreases) effort in the second match of the 0%-treatment (100%-treatment). Additional findings suggest that dynamic behavior is also subject to a psychological momentum.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究了奖金结构如何影响三人序贯循环赛的强度、公平性和动态行为。我们比较了二等奖分别等于一等奖的0%、50%或100%的锦标赛。虽然理论预测50%处理组的比赛强度最高，但我们发现总努力在0%处理组中最高。相反，我们的证据支持50%处理组最公平（尽管并非完全公平）的预测，而100%处理组中后动者占优，0%处理组中后动者处于劣势。同样与理论一致，我们识别出一种策略性（反向）动量：在赢得第一场比赛后，玩家在0%处理组（100%处理组）的第二场比赛中增加（减少）努力。额外发现表明，动态行为也受到心理动量的影响。

articles.title_en: Reciprocity and gift exchange in markets for credence goods
articles.title_cn: 信任品市场中的互惠与礼物交换
articles.abstract_en: We study the role of reciprocity in markets where expert-sellers have more information about the severity of a problem faced by a consumer. We employ a standard experimental credence goods market to introduce the possibility for consumers to gift the expert-seller before the diagnostic, where the gift is either transferred unconditionally or conditionally on solving the problem. We find that both types of gifts increase the frequency of consumer-friendly actions relative to no gift, but only conditional gifts translate into efficiency gains when the consumer faces a high-severity problem. This suggests that partial alignment of incentives via conditional gifts may outweigh kindness motives when reciprocal actions are not directly observed. Using further treatments with surprise gift exchange, we show that withholding a gift that is expected by expert-sellers significantly reduces the likelihood of consumer-friendly behavior whereas sending a gift to expert-sellers who do not expect one has no effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在专家卖方对消费者面临问题的严重程度拥有更多信息的市场中，互惠所扮演的角色。我们采用标准的实验性信任品市场，引入消费者在诊断前向专家卖方赠送礼物的可能性，其中礼物要么无条件转移，要么以解决问题为条件。我们发现，与不赠送礼物相比，两种类型的礼物都增加了消费者友好行为的频率，但只有条件性礼物在消费者面临高严重性问题时转化为效率提升。这表明，当互惠行为不被直接观察时，通过条件性礼物实现的部分激励对齐可能超过善意动机。通过进一步使用惊喜礼物交换的处理，我们表明，扣留专家卖方期望的礼物显著降低了消费者友好行为的可能性，而向不期望礼物的专家卖方发送礼物则没有影响。

articles.title_en: Trustworthy by design
articles.title_cn: 设计中的可信性
articles.abstract_en: We explore theoretically and experimentally whether information design can be used by trustees as a signaling device to boost trusting acts. In our main setting, a trustee partially or fully decides a binary payoff allocation and designs an information structure, then a trustor decides whether to invest. In the control setting, information design is not available. In line with the standard equilibrium analysis, we find that introducing information design increases trustworthiness and trusting acts, and some trustees choose full trustworthiness with the most informative structure. We also find systematic behavioral deviations, including some trustees' choosing zero trustworthiness with the least informative structure and trustors' overtrusting in low informative structures. We finally provide a model of heterogeneity in prosociality and strategic sophistication, which rationalizes the experimental findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们从理论和实验上探讨受托人是否可以将信息设计用作信号装置，以促进信任行为。在我们的主要设定中，受托人部分或完全决定二元收益分配并设计信息结构，然后委托人决定是否投资。在控制设定中，信息设计不可用。与标准均衡分析一致，我们发现引入信息设计提高了可信性和信任行为，一些受托人选择具有最具信息量结构的完全可信性。我们还发现了系统性行为偏差，包括一些受托人选择具有最不具信息量结构的零可信性，以及委托人在低信息量结构中的过度信任。最后，我们提供了一个关于亲社会性和策略性成熟度异质性的模型，该模型合理化了实验结果。

articles.title_en: An experiment on the Nash program: A comparison of two strategic mechanisms implementing the Shapley value
articles.title_cn: 纳什程序实验：两种实施沙普利值的战略机制比较
articles.abstract_en: We experimentally compare two well-known mechanisms inducing the Shapley value as an ex ante equilibrium outcome of a noncooperative bargaining procedure: the demand-based Winter's demand commitment bargaining mechanism and the offer-based Hart and Mas-Colell procedure. Our results suggest that the offer-based Hart and Mas-Colell mechanism better induces players to cooperate and to agree on an efficient outcome, whereas the demand-based Winter mechanism better implements allocations that reflect players' effective power, provided that the grand coalition is formed.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们实验比较了两种众所周知的机制，它们将沙普利值作为非合作谈判程序的预期均衡结果：基于需求的温特需求承诺谈判机制和基于提议的哈特-马斯-科莱尔程序。我们的结果表明，基于提议的哈特-马斯-科莱尔机制更能促使玩家合作并就有效结果达成一致，而基于需求的温特机制在形成大联盟的前提下，能更好地实施反映玩家实际权力的分配。

articles.title_en: Motives behind cooperation in finitely repeated prisoner's dilemma
articles.title_cn: 有限重复囚徒困境中合作背后的动机
articles.abstract_en: This paper deploys a novel experiment to compare three behavioral theories that explain both selfish and non-selfish cooperation. The three theories fuse reputational cooperation (à la Kreps et al. (1982)) with the following three non-selfish motives respectively: caring about others (Altruism), being conscientious about cooperation (Duty), and enjoying social-efficiency (Efficiency-Seeking). We use reputational cooperation under purely Selfish preferences as a fourth theory. Our experimental design varies the decline-rate of future rewards, under which these theories predict rich patterns of behavior. Based on a Finite Mixture Model, the data is best explained if the modal subject types are Selfish and Efficiency-Seeking: We estimate that 40-49% of our subjects are Selfish, 36-45% are Efficiency-seeking, and 6-20% are Altruistic. We find little evidence for Duty players.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文采用一种新颖的实验来比较三种行为理论，这些理论解释了自私和非自私的合作。这三种理论分别将声誉合作（如Kreps等人（1982）所述）与以下三种非自私动机相结合：关心他人（利他主义）、对合作有责任心（义务）以及享受社会效率（效率寻求）。我们将纯粹自私偏好下的声誉合作作为第四种理论。我们的实验设计改变了未来奖励的递减率，在这些理论下，这些理论预测了丰富的行为模式。基于有限混合模型，数据最好地解释了模态主体类型为自私型和效率寻求型：我们估计约有40-49%的主体是自私的，36-45%是效率寻求型的，6-20%是利他主义的。我们几乎没有发现义务型参与者的证据。

articles.title_en: Minority turnout and representation under cumulative voting. An experiment
articles.title_cn: 少数族裔在累积投票制下的投票率与代表性：一项实验
articles.abstract_en: Under majoritarian election systems, securing the participation and representation of minorities remains an open problem, made salient in the US by its history of voter suppression. One remedy recommended by the courts is the adoption of Cumulative Voting (CV) in multi-member districts: each voter has as many votes as open positions but can cumulate votes on as few candidates as desired. Historical experiences are promising but also reflect episodes of minority activism. We present the results of a controlled lab experiment that isolates the role of the voting rule from other confounds. Although each voter is treated equally, theory predicts that CV should increase the minority's turnout relative to the majority and the minority's share of seats won. The experimental results strongly support both theoretical predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 在多数决选举制度下，确保少数族裔的参与和代表性仍是一个未解决的问题，美国历史上压制选民的做法使这一问题尤为突出。法院推荐的一种补救措施是在多席位选区采用累积投票制（CV）：每位选民拥有的票数与待选职位数相同，但可以将票数集中投给任意少数候选人。历史经验令人鼓舞，但也反映了少数族裔积极行动的片段。我们展示了一项受控实验室实验的结果，该实验隔离了投票规则与其他混杂因素的作用。尽管每位选民受到平等对待，理论预测累积投票制应提高少数族裔相对于多数族裔的投票率以及少数族裔赢得的席位比例。实验结果有力地支持了这两个理论预测。

articles.title_en: Some characterizations of Generalized Top Trading Cycles
articles.title_cn: 广义顶级交易循环的若干刻画
articles.abstract_en: Consider object exchange problems when each agent may be endowed with and consume more than one object. For most domains of preferences, no rule satisfies efficiency, the endowment lower bound, and strategy-proofness. Insisting on the first two properties, we explore the extent to which weaker incentive compatibility can be achieved. Motivated by behavioral and computational considerations as well as online mechanisms, we define several forms of manipulation. We consider the lexicographic domain of preferences, and provide several characterizations of Generalized Top Trading Cycles based on properties concerning immunity from heuristic and identity-splitting manipulations. We also show that this establishes a boundary with respect to incentive compatibility—minimal strengthening results in impossibility.
articles.abstract_cn: 考虑当每个代理人可能被赋予并消费多于一个物品时的物品交换问题。对于大多数偏好域，没有规则同时满足效率、禀赋下界和策略证明性。坚持前两个性质，我们探索在多大程度上可以实现较弱的激励相容性。受行为与计算考虑以及在线机制的启发，我们定义了多种操纵形式。我们考虑字典序偏好域，并基于免疫启发式操纵和身份分裂操纵的性质，提供了广义顶级交易循环的若干刻画。我们还表明，这建立了关于激励相容性的一个边界——最小强化导致不可能性。

articles.title_en: Does free information provision crowd out costly information acquisition? It's a matter of timing
articles.title_cn: 免费信息提供是否会挤出昂贵的信息获取？这是一个时机问题
articles.abstract_en: Conventional wisdom suggests that promising free information to an agent would crowd out costly information acquisition. We theoretically demonstrate that this intuition only holds as a knife-edge case in which priors are symmetric. Indeed, when priors are asymmetric, a promise of free information in the future induces agents to increase information acquisition. In the lab, we test whether such crowding out occurs for both symmetric and asymmetric priors. Our results are qualitatively in line with the predictions: When priors are asymmetric, the promise of future free information induces subjects to acquire more costly information.
articles.abstract_cn: 传统观点认为，向代理人承诺提供免费信息会挤出昂贵的信息获取行为。我们从理论上证明，这一直觉仅在先验对称的刀锋情形下成立。实际上，当先验不对称时，未来免费信息的承诺会促使代理人增加信息获取。在实验室中，我们检验了这种挤出效应是否在对称和不对称先验下均会发生。我们的结果在定性上与预测一致：当先验不对称时，未来免费信息的承诺会促使受试者获取更多昂贵的信息。

articles.title_en: Beyond uncertainty aversion
articles.title_cn: 超越不确定性厌恶
articles.abstract_en: Although much of the theoretical and applied literature involving decision under ambiguity works under the assumption of uncertainty aversion, experimental evidence suggests that it is not a universal behavioural trait. This paper introduces and axiomatises the family of α-UA (for α-Uncertainty Attitude) preferences: a simple extension of uncertainty averse preferences with a Hurwicz-style mixing coefficient, so as to admit a richer range of uncertainty attitudes. The parameters of the model are uniquely identified in our characterisation. It provides, in the Hurwicz α-maxmin EU special case, a new resolution of a long-standing identification problem. It also yields novel models, including extensions of variational and multiplier preferences. Comparative statics support the interpretation of the mixing coefficient as an index of imprecision aversion. In a standard portfolio problem, the model yields the intuitive relationship between imprecision aversion and investment in an uncertain asset: as the former increases, the latter decreases.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管涉及模糊决策的理论和应用文献大多在不确定性厌恶的假设下进行，但实验证据表明，这并非普遍的行为特征。本文引入并公理化了一族α-UA（即α-不确定性态度）偏好：这是不确定性厌恶偏好的简单扩展，加入了Hurwicz风格的混合系数，从而容纳更广泛的不确定性态度。在我们的刻画中，模型的参数被唯一识别。在Hurwicz α-maxmin EU特例中，它为长期存在的识别问题提供了新的解决方案。它还产生了新颖的模型，包括变分和乘子偏好的扩展。比较静态分析支持将混合系数解释为不精确厌恶指数的观点。在标准投资组合问题中，该模型产生了不精确厌恶与不确定资产投资之间的直观关系：前者增加，后者减少。

articles.title_en: Fisher markets with linear constraints: Equilibrium properties and efficient distributed algorithms
articles.title_cn: 具有线性约束的费雪市场：均衡性质与高效分布式算法
articles.abstract_en: The Fisher market is one of the most fundamental models for resource allocation. However, Fisher markets are less amenable for resource allocation settings when agents have additional linear constraints beyond the budget constraints of buyers and the capacity constraints of goods. Thus, in this work, we introduce a modified Fisher market, where agents may have additional linear constraints, and study the properties of the resulting equilibria. To set equilibrium prices, we introduce a budget-adjusted social optimization problem (BA-SOP), whose optimal dual variables correspond to the equilibrium prices. Since solving BA-SOP can be computationally intensive and requires centralized knowledge of all agents' utilities, we propose a new class of distributed algorithms based on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) to compute equilibrium prices. Our ADMM approach has strong convergence guarantees and provides a general-purpose method for computing market equilibria for Fisher markets with homogeneous linear constraints and classical Fisher markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 费雪市场是资源分配中最基本的模型之一。然而，当代理人除了买方的预算约束和商品的容量约束之外还有额外的线性约束时，费雪市场不太适用于资源分配设置。因此，在这项工作中，我们引入了一个修改后的费雪市场，其中代理人可能有额外的线性约束，并研究由此产生的均衡的性质。为了设定均衡价格，我们引入了一个预算调整的社会优化问题（BA-SOP），其最优对偶变量对应于均衡价格。由于求解BA-SOP可能计算密集且需要所有代理人效用的集中知识，我们提出了一类基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的新型分布式算法来计算均衡价格。我们的ADMM方法具有强收敛保证，并为计算具有齐次线性约束的费雪市场和经典费雪市场的市场均衡提供了一种通用方法。

articles.title_en: Increasing the external validity of social preference games by reducing measurement error
articles.title_cn: 通过减少测量误差提高社会偏好博弈的外部效度
articles.abstract_en: An increasing number of studies call into question the external validity of social preference games. In this paper, we show that these games have a low correlation with single pro-social behaviors in the field, but this correlation can be substantially increased by aggregating behaviors to reduce measurement error. We tracked people's daily pro-social behaviors for 14 days using a day reconstruction method; the same people played three different social preference games on seven different occasions. We show that, as more pro-social behaviors and game rounds are aggregated, the games become much better predictors of pro-sociality. This predictive power is further increased by using statistical methods designed to better account for measurement error. These findings suggest that social preference games capture important underlying dispositions of real-world pro-sociality, and they can be successfully used to predict aggregated pro-social inclinations. This has crucial implications for the external validity and applicability of economic games.
articles.abstract_cn: 越来越多的研究对社会偏好博弈的外部效度提出质疑。在本文中，我们表明这些博弈与实地中的单一亲社会行为相关性较低，但通过聚合行为以减少测量误差，这种相关性可以显著提高。我们使用日重建法追踪了人们14天的日常亲社会行为；同一批人在七个不同场合玩了三种不同的社会偏好博弈。我们表明，随着更多的亲社会行为和博弈轮次被聚合，博弈成为亲社会性更好的预测指标。通过使用旨在更好地考虑测量误差的统计方法，这种预测能力进一步增强。这些发现表明，社会偏好博弈捕捉了现实世界亲社会性的重要潜在倾向，并且可以成功地用于预测聚合的亲社会倾向。这对经济博弈的外部效度和适用性具有关键意义。

articles.title_en: On the manipulability of equitable voting rules
articles.title_cn: 论公平投票规则的可操纵性
articles.abstract_en: We consider the equity-manipulability trade-off when voting over two alternatives. Pairwise equity is a weakening of anonymity requiring certain permutations of the voters' identities to preserve the outcome of the election. ℓ-robust group strategy-proofness (ℓ-RGSP) and fine robust group strategy-proofness (FRGSP) are notions of group strategy-proofness that allow voters to have different beliefs about players' types (Kivinen and Tumennasan, 2021). Our main results show that, under mild conditions, for pairwise equitable voting rules anonymity is equivalent to 2-RGSP, 3-RGSP, and FRGSP. In this way, anonymity is special in its equity and non-manipulability. These results follow from several preliminary results, one of which equates 2-RGSP to comonotonicity and swap-robustness. Finally, we consider the manipulability of k-unanimous rules, and 2-RGSP when agents can be indifferent and abstain.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑在两种备选方案投票中的公平性与可操纵性之间的权衡。两两公平是匿名性的一种弱化，要求选民的某些身份置换不改变选举结果。ℓ-稳健群体策略-proofness（ℓ-RGSP）和精细稳健群体策略-proofness（FRGSP）是群体策略-proofness的概念，允许选民对参与者类型持有不同信念（Kivinen和Tumennasan，2021）。我们的主要结果表明，在温和条件下，对于两两公平的投票规则，匿名性等价于2-RGSP、3-RGSP和FRGSP。这样，匿名性在其公平性和不可操纵性方面具有特殊性。这些结果源于若干初步结果，其中之一将2-RGSP等同于共单调性和交换稳健性。最后，我们考虑k-一致规则的可操纵性，以及当代理人可以无差异和弃权时的2-RGSP。

articles.title_en: Incentive compatibility in sender-receiver stopping games
articles.title_cn: 发送者-接收者停止博弈中的激励相容性
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a model of sender-receiver stopping games, in which the sender observes the current state, and sends a message to the receiver to either stop the game, or to continue. The receiver, only seeing the message, then decides to stop the game, or to continue. The payoff to each player is a function of the state when the receiver quits, with higher states leading to better payoffs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个发送者-接收者停止博弈模型，其中发送者观察当前状态，并向接收者发送信息以停止博弈或继续。接收者仅看到信息，然后决定停止博弈或继续。每个参与者的收益是接收者退出时状态的函数，状态越高，收益越好。

articles.title_en: Fairness for multi-self agents
articles.title_cn: 多自我主体的公平性
articles.abstract_en: Are fairness and efficiency compatible in behavioral welfare economics? Assuming multi-self agents, who may not be able to integrate their various objectives into complete and transitive rankings, we call an allocation unambiguously-fair if it fair according to every self of every agent. We show that efficiency is generically compatible with the unambiguous fair-share guarantee, and — in two agent economies — with unambiguous no-envy. But in some larger economies, no efficient allocation satisfies unambiguous no-envy or unambiguous egalitarian equivalence. These non-existence results persist if the agents integrate their objectives into complete but intransitive rankings. Even if unambiguously envy-free Pareto optima exist, they may not arise as market equilibria from equal endowments. Finally, we show that there are Pareto optima with the unambiguous fair-share guarantee that are envy-free for at least one complete and transitive aggregation of the agents' preferences, and others that are egalitarian-equivalent according to at least one such aggregation.
articles.abstract_cn: 在行为福利经济学中，公平与效率是否兼容？假设多自我主体可能无法将其各种目标整合为完备且传递的排序，我们称一个配置为无歧义公平的，如果它根据每个主体的每个自我都是公平的。我们证明，效率通常与无歧义公平份额保证兼容，并且在两人经济中，与无歧义无嫉妒兼容。但在一些更大的经济体中，没有有效配置满足无歧义无嫉妒或无歧义平等主义等价。如果主体将其目标整合为完备但不传递的排序，这些不存在性结果仍然存在。即使无歧义无嫉妒的帕累托最优存在，它们也可能不会作为来自平等禀赋的市场均衡出现。最后，我们表明，存在具有无歧义公平份额保证的帕累托最优，这些最优至少对于主体偏好的一个完备且传递的聚合是无嫉妒的，并且其他最优至少根据一个这样的聚合是平等主义等价的。

articles.title_en: Stable sharing
articles.title_cn: 稳定分享
articles.abstract_en: We propose a simple model in which agents are matched in pairs in order to complete a task of unit size. The preferences of agents are single-peaked and continuous on the amount of time they devote to it. Our model combines features of two models: assignment games (Shapley and Shubik (1971)) and the division problem (Sprumont (1991)). We provide an algorithm (Select-Allocate-Match) that generates a stable and Pareto efficient allocation. We show that stable allocations may fail to exist if either the single-peakedness or the continuity assumption fail.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个简单模型，其中代理人被两两配对以完成一个单位大小的任务。代理人的偏好是单峰且连续的，关于他们投入任务的时间量。我们的模型结合了两个模型的特征：指派博弈（Shapley和Shubik（1971））和分配问题（Sprumont（1991））。我们提供了一种算法（选择-分配-匹配），该算法生成稳定且帕累托有效的分配。我们表明，如果单峰性或连续性假设不成立，稳定分配可能不存在。

articles.title_en: A planner-optimal matching mechanism and its incentive compatibility in a restricted domain
articles.title_cn: 受限域中的规划者最优匹配机制及其激励相容性
articles.abstract_en: In many random assignment problems, the central planner pursues their own policy objective, such as matching size and minimum quota fulfillment. Several practically important policy objectives do not align with agents' preferences and are known to be incompatible with strategy-proofness. This paper demonstrates that such policy objectives can be attained using mechanisms that satisfy Bayesian incentive compatibility within a restricted domain of von Neumann Morgenstern utilities. We establish that a mechanism satisfies Bayesian incentive compatibility in an inverse-bounded-indifference domain if and only if the mechanism satisfies the three axioms of swap monotonicity, lower invariance, and interior upper variance. We apply this axiomatic characterization to analyze the incentive property of the constrained random serial dictatorship mechanism (CRSD). CRSD is designed to generate an individually rational assignment that optimizes the central planner's policy objective function. Since CRSD satisfies these axioms, it is Bayesian incentive compatible within an IBI domain.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多随机分配问题中，中央规划者追求自身的政策目标，例如匹配规模和最低配额满足。若干实际重要的政策目标与参与者的偏好不一致，并且已知与策略防护性不相容。本文证明，此类政策目标可以通过在冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦效用的受限域内满足贝叶斯激励相容性的机制来实现。我们确立，一个机制在逆有界无差异域中满足贝叶斯激励相容性，当且仅当该机制满足交换单调性、下不变性和内部上方差这三个公理。我们应用这一公理化特征来剖析受约束随机独裁机制（CRSD）的激励性质。CRSD旨在生成一个个体理性分配，优化中央规划者的政策目标函数。由于CRSD满足这些公理，它在IBI域内是贝叶斯激励相容的。

articles.title_en: Targeting in social networks with anonymized information
articles.title_cn: 匿名信息下社交网络中的定向干预
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal targeting when the planner knows the architecture of the network but not the identities of agents occupying different positions in the network. We show that the planner's ability to discriminate among agents depends on the balance between in- and out-neighborhoods in the social network. When influence is reciprocal, the knowledge of the network architecture is sufficient for the planner to implement the first-best actions. When in- and out-neighborhoods are imbalanced, pairs of players have an incentive to jointly misreport their identities. This situation arises when one agent influences all other agents, or when one agent is being influenced by all other agents. It also arises in hierarchical structures with nested neighborhoods where agents at lower tiers of the network are influenced by the same agents as agents at upper tiers who influence them.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当规划者了解网络结构但不知道占据网络中不同位置的代理人身份时的最优定向干预问题。我们表明，规划者区分代理人的能力取决于社交网络中入邻域和出邻域之间的平衡。当影响是互惠的时，对网络结构的了解足以使规划者实施最优行动。当入邻域和出邻域不平衡时，成对的参与者有动机联合虚报其身份。这种情况出现在一个代理人影响所有其他代理人，或一个代理人被所有其他代理人影响时。它也出现在具有嵌套邻域的层级结构中，其中网络较低层的代理人受到与较高层代理人相同的代理人影响，而这些较高层代理人又影响他们。

articles.title_en: Prioritized organ allocation rules under compatibility constraints
articles.title_cn: 兼容性约束下的优先器官分配规则
articles.abstract_en: We study the efficacy of the donor-priority rule in promoting deceased organ donation under blood-type compatibility constraints in both theory and the laboratory. Compared with an allocation policy in which transplantations are performed only within the same blood-type group, we find that transferring organs across blood-type compatible groups discourages the donation incentives of hard-to-match agents and reduces the supply of the more widely acceptable type of organ. Meanwhile, the easy-to-match agents have higher incentives to donate. At the aggregate level, both our theoretical and experimental results suggest that the aggregate donation rate is lower under allocation policies that allow blood-type compatible transplants among different blood-type groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在理论和实验室中研究了在血型兼容性约束下，捐赠者优先规则在促进 deceased 器官捐献方面的有效性。与仅在相同血型组内进行移植的分配政策相比，我们发现跨血型兼容组转移器官会抑制难以匹配的代理人的捐赠激励，并减少更广泛可接受类型器官的供应。同时，易于匹配的代理人具有更高的捐赠激励。在总体水平上，我们的理论和实验结果均表明，在允许不同血型组之间进行血型兼容移植的分配政策下，总体捐赠率较低。

articles.title_en: Balanced equilibrium in pseudo-markets with endowments
articles.title_cn: 禀赋伪市场中的均衡均衡
articles.abstract_en: In a variant of Hylland and Zeckhauser (1979)'s model that allows agents to start out with different endowments, we develop a pseudo-market procedure that allows the policymaker to decide to what extent individual endowment differences shall be balanced by the average endowment. Our procedure sidesteps the known non-existence problem of Walrasian equilibria, and finds an efficient and balanced individually-rational allocation. Envy in our procedure is justified in a utilitarian sense: an envying agent's endowment must make a lower contribution to standard weighted utilitarian welfare than that of the envied agent.
articles.abstract_cn: 在Hylland和Zeckhauser（1979）模型的一个变体中，该变体允许代理人以不同的初始禀赋开始，我们开发了一种伪市场程序，使政策制定者能够决定个体禀赋差异应在多大程度上由平均禀赋来平衡。我们的程序绕过了已知的瓦尔拉斯均衡不存在问题，并找到了一种高效且平衡的个体理性配置。在我们的程序中，嫉妒在功利主义意义上是合理的：嫉妒者的禀赋对标准加权功利主义福利的贡献必须低于被嫉妒者的禀赋。

articles.title_en: Polytope-form games and index/degree theories for extensive-form games
articles.title_cn: 多面体形式博弈与扩展式博弈的指标/度理论
articles.abstract_en: We develop index and degree theories for extensive form games allowing the identification of equilibria that are robust to payoff perturbations directly from the extensive form. Our approach is based on index and degree theories for games where the strategy sets are polytopes (and not necessarily simplices) and payoff functions are multiaffine. Polytope strategy sets arise naturally from topologically identifying equivalent mixed strategies of a normal form game.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为扩展式博弈发展了指标和度理论，使得能够直接从扩展式中识别对收益扰动稳健的均衡。我们的方法基于策略集为多面体（不一定是单纯形）且收益函数为多重仿射的博弈的指标和度理论。多面体策略集自然产生于对正规形式博弈的等价混合策略进行拓扑识别。

articles.title_en: Attacking a nuclear facility: The impact of a noisy intelligence with unknown quality
articles.title_cn: 攻击核设施：未知质量噪声情报的影响
articles.abstract_en: This note stems from Jelnov et al. (2017), which analyzed the interaction of two enemy nations– Player 1 (the weak nation) and Player 2 (the strong nation). 1 (he) wishes to develop a nuclear bomb, and 2 (she) who employs a noisy intelligence system, IS, aims to deter him. Based on the signal sent by IS, 2 decides whether to attack 1. If the precision (α) of IS is commonly known, not only 2 is strictly better off with a better quality (higher precision) IS but also is 1. In contrast, this note shows that if α is 2's private information, 1 is not necessarily better off from a more accurate IS, and 2 is only weakly better off. Moreover, the equilibrium outcome depends on 1's estimate of IS's precision (E(α)). A greater estimated precision leads to less aggressive behaviors of both players, thereby reducing the chance of a conflict.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文源于Jelnov等人（2017）的研究，该研究分析了两个敌对国家的互动——玩家1（弱国）和玩家2（强国）。1（他）希望发展核弹，而2（她）采用噪声情报系统IS，旨在威慑他。基于IS发送的信号，2决定是否攻击1。如果IS的精度（α）是共同知识，那么不仅2在拥有更好质量（更高精度）的IS时严格受益，1也如此。相反，本文表明，如果α是2的私人信息，1不一定从更精确的IS中受益，而2仅弱受益。此外，均衡结果取决于1对IS精度的估计（E(α)）。更大的估计精度导致双方玩家的攻击性行为减少，从而降低冲突的可能性。

articles.title_en: Unethical decision making and sleep restriction: Experimental evidence
articles.title_cn: 不道德决策与睡眠限制：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Insufficient sleep is costly to organizations (e.g., direct health costs, cognitive errors, accident risk, and lower labor productivity). In this current study, we examine another more hidden cost associated with insufficient sleep– unethical behaviors. Using a hybrid field/lab experimental approach, participants were randomly assigned to a week of sleep-restriction or well-rested sleep levels in their at-home (naturalistic) environment prior to decision making. We found that sleep restricted participants cheated significantly more in two honesty tasks, while anti-social choices were, surprisingly, not affected. Because sleep restriction promotes reduced deliberation, these results contribute to our understanding of the cognitive underpinnings of decision making. Importantly, these findings have practical implications to managers who want to reduce dishonesty in the workplace. For example, our results suggest that workplace health promotion programs focused on good sleep hygiene would additionally benefit the company in terms of indirectly promoting ethical conduct in the workplace.
articles.abstract_cn: 睡眠不足对组织而言代价高昂（例如，直接健康成本、认知错误、事故风险以及较低的劳动生产率）。在本研究中，我们考察了与睡眠不足相关的另一个更为隐蔽的成本——不道德行为。采用混合实地/实验室实验方法，参与者在决策前被随机分配到家中（自然）环境中一周的睡眠限制或充足睡眠水平。我们发现，睡眠受限的参与者在两项诚实任务中作弊显著更多，而反社会选择则出人意料地未受影响。由于睡眠限制减少了深思熟虑，这些结果有助于我们理解决策的认知基础。重要的是，这些发现对希望减少工作场所不诚实行为的管理者具有实际意义。例如，我们的结果表明，专注于良好睡眠卫生的工作场所健康促进计划将额外使公司受益，因为其间接促进了工作场所的道德行为。

articles.title_en: Epistemic foundation of the backward induction paradox
articles.title_cn: 逆向归纳悖论的认识论基础
articles.abstract_en: After having observed a deviation from backward induction, a player might deem the opponent prone to deviate from backward induction again, making it worthwhile to deviate themself. Such reaction might make the deviation by the opponent worthwhile in the first place—which is the backward induction paradox. This argument against backward induction cannot be made in games where all players choose only once on each path. While strategic-form perfect equilibrium yields backward induction in games where players choose only once on each path but not necessarily otherwise, no existing non-equilibrium concept captures the backward induction paradox by having these properties. To provide such a concept, we define and epistemically characterize the concept of independently permissible strategies. Since beliefs are modeled by non-Archimedean probabilities, meaning that some opponent choices might be assigned subjective probability zero without being deemed subjectively impossible, special attention is paid to the formalization of stochastically independent beliefs.
articles.abstract_cn: 在观察到偏离逆向归纳的行为后，一个参与者可能认为对手倾向于再次偏离逆向归纳，从而使自己偏离也变得值得。这种反应可能使对手的偏离在一开始就是值得的——这就是逆向归纳悖论。这一反对逆向归纳的论证在每条路径上每个参与者只选择一次的博弈中无法成立。虽然策略型完美均衡在每条路径上每个参与者只选择一次的博弈中产生逆向归纳结果，但在其他情况下则不一定，现有的非均衡概念中没有一个能通过具有这些性质来捕捉逆向归纳悖论。为了提供这样一个概念，我们定义并认识论地表征了独立可允许策略的概念。由于信念通过非阿基米德概率建模，这意味着某些对手的选择可能被赋予主观概率零而不被视为主观上不可能，因此特别关注随机独立信念的形式化。

articles.title_en: The cost of strategy-proofness in school choice
articles.title_cn: 学校选择中策略防范的成本
articles.abstract_en: We compare the outcomes of the most prominent strategy-proof and stable algorithm (Deferred Acceptance, DA) and the most prominent strategy-proof and Pareto optimal algorithm (Top Trading Cycles, TTC) to the allocation generated by the rank-minimizing mechanism (RM). While one would expect that RM improves upon both DA and TTC in terms of rank efficiency, the size of the improvement is nonetheless surprising. Moreover, while it is not explicitly designed to do so, RM also significantly improves the placement of the worst-off student. Furthermore, RM generates less justified envy than TTC. We corroborate our findings using data on school admissions in Budapest.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们比较了最著名的策略防范且稳定的算法（延迟接受，DA）和最著名的策略防范且帕累托最优的算法（顶级交易循环，TTC）与排名最小化机制（RM）产生的分配结果。虽然人们会预期RM在排名效率方面优于DA和TTC，但改进的幅度仍然令人惊讶。此外，尽管RM并非明确设计用于此目的，它也显著改善了最差处境学生的安置。再者，RM产生的合理嫉妒少于TTC。我们使用布达佩斯学校招生的数据证实了我们的发现。

articles.title_en: Unique stable matchings
articles.title_cn: 唯一稳定匹配
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we consider the issue of a unique prediction in one-to-one two-sided matching markets, as defined by Gale and Shapley (1962), and we prove the following: TheoremLet P be a one-to-one two-sided matching market and letP⁎be its associated normal form, a (weakly) smaller matching market with the same set of stable matchings that can be obtained using procedures introduced inIrving and Leather (1986)andBalinski and Ratier (1997). The following three statements are equivalent:(a)P has a unique stable matching.(b)Preferences onP⁎are acyclic, as defined byChung (2000).(c)InP⁎every market participant's preference list is a singleton.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考虑由Gale和Shapley（1962）定义的一对一双边匹配市场中的唯一预测问题，并证明以下定理：设P是一个一对一双边匹配市场，P⁎是其关联的规范形式，一个（弱）更小的匹配市场，具有相同的稳定匹配集合，可通过Irving和Leather（1986）以及Balinski和Ratier（1997）引入的程序获得。以下三个陈述等价：（a）P具有唯一稳定匹配。（b）P⁎上的偏好是无环的，如Chung（2000）所定义。（c）在P⁎中，每个市场参与者的偏好列表是单元素集。

articles.title_en: Expropriation power in private dealings: Quota rule in collective sales
articles.title_cn: 私人交易中的征收权：集体销售中的配额规则
articles.abstract_en: Complementarity is common in land-assembly problems, such as a developer buying the entirety of apartment units to complete a development project. Holdout (delay or block of projects by sellers) is common in these problems under unanimity-rule. Motivated by the recent policy practices in strata-sales, we introduce a new bargaining model with quota-rule. We show that under quota-rule, there is no holdout when there are two sellers or players are sufficiently patient. No-holdout equilibrium is unique, efficient and yields immediate sale of all goods as outcome. When quota rule is used, efficient equilibrium is still obtained under alternative bargaining protocols and with multiple sellers. We also show that the no-holdout result is not due to the specific bargaining protocol.
articles.abstract_cn: 互补性在土地整合问题中很常见，例如开发商购买全部公寓单元以完成开发项目。在一致同意规则下，这些问题的卖方抵制（卖方拖延或阻止项目）很常见。受近期分层销售政策实践的启发，我们引入了一个带有配额规则的新议价模型。我们表明，在配额规则下，当有两个卖方或参与者足够有耐心时，不存在抵制。无抵制均衡是唯一的、有效的，并且导致所有商品立即出售的结果。当使用配额规则时，在替代议价协议和多个卖方的情况下，仍然可以获得有效均衡。我们还表明，无抵制结果并非由于特定的议价协议所致。
